### Senior Software Engineer

Remote

Published
1 year ago


### **About us**

Rasayel is building the future of business messaging on WhatsApp.

We help businesses support, sell, and market to their customers directly inside messaging apps starting with WhatsApp. We’ve just raised our seed round and we’re growing a focused, ambitious, and world-class team to help us build intelligent software that truly works _with_ people, not just for them.

We’re designers, engineers, and product folks from Intercom, Instabug, and Evervault. We’ve contributed to beloved OSS like vee-validate. We care about shipping thoughtful, high-quality products without big tech’s bureaucracy or fluff.

We’re remote, sharp, kind, and serious about doing meaningful work and we’re just getting started.

### **What you’ll do**

You’ll work as part of a small, senior team to build AI-powered tools that revolutionise how businesses sell on WhatsApp.

- Design and build real-time agents that help sales teams re-engage leads, book meetings, and close deals all while keeping the human touch.
- Create intelligent layers that sit on top of WhatsApp conversations, surfacing key insights and integrating smoothly with our backend.
- Own complex problems end-to-end, from vague idea to working code in production.
- Collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering to build elegant, high-performance systems.

### **You might be a great fit if...**

- You’re a product-minded engineer who cares about outcomes, not just features.
- You care about solving real user problems with empathy, clarity, and intent, not just writing code, but thinking deeply about _why_ it matters and _how_ it delivers value
- You think from first principles and love breaking complex problems into simple ones.
- You write clear, well-tested, and maintainable code and care about the people who’ll read it next.
- You’re pragmatic and don’t mind wearing different hats depending on what’s needed.
- You like working in small teams where your impact is huge and your voice matters.

**Technically, you probably have experience with:**

- Ruby on Rails (you know your way around its internals if needed)
- PostgreSQL (and raw SQL when needed)
- Building and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL and knowing when to use which)
- JavaScript, TypeScript, and ideally Vue.js
- Writing and maintaining meaningful test suites
- Cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS, Docker, ECS)
- Some DevOps work under your belt (infra, monitoring, deployment, etc.)

You don’t need to check every single box. If you’re close and excited, we want to hear from you.

### **How we work**

- Fully remote, async-friendly, low-meeting culture
- No middle managers, just teammates who care about doing great work together
- Transparent, kind, and feedback-friendly environment
- Fast, focused product cycles, we bias for action and clarity
- We write a lot (docs, specs, commits, code comments) and value strong communication

### **What we offer**

- Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity
- A remote setup that works for you (hardware, equipment, etc.)
- Autonomy, ownership, and zero micromanagement
- The chance to build product and infra that really matters and to have a say in _what_ we build and _how_

### **Interested?**

We’d love to hear from you. Get in touch directly with Shane (shane@rasayel.io)

- A quick note on why you’re interested and what excites you about the role
- Your CV, LinkedIn, or GitHub
- Bonus points for links to anything you’ve built or contributed to — especially open source

Let us know something personal so we know you actually read this. 😉
